en: Oh, don't be like that. Just a quick look, eh?
No means no!
(A mere human, daring to want to touch Orgo!)
note: Orgo = the bat familiar disguised as the necktie (glossary)

en: These days I'm interested in all sorts of
things besides jewels. I've even invested in
this town's glass works and such, you know.
Well, I've plied many trades since my youth,
but money never hurts to have, after all.
Won't you let me have a good close look at
that necktie of yours, just once?
What, no? What a stingy fellow.
Calling at this hour?
Y-you're not a burglar, are you?!
I'm afraid all my jewels are kept at the shop,
and there's no great sum of money in this house.
No, what I want
is neither jewels nor money.
It is your blood
"Blood," you say
note: followed by three #180 ('...'); next row #4579 is Dellwald's scream in the same message

en: Nngyaaah
note: used in msg 177477 (Dellwald's scream as he is bitten), though used_in was empty

en: I don't recall giving a young whelp like you
leave to be so familiar with me.
, is it?
That's not a name one hears very often.
I won't have a whelp like you so familiar.
Don't be so familiar with me.
What an impertinent fellow.
Oh, I'm terribly sorry.
(Oops, I got told off.)
Listen,
it's best to start saving money while young.
Sorry, but I've no time to chat with you.
I'll have to ask you to leave.
This is a jeweler's. We've no use for whelps.
Hmm, you may be young, but you don't seem
note: joins shared #4543 'to be a pauper, at least.'

en: Hmm, everything is beautifully displayed.
Every stone is lovely
Well, back again, are you?
Thinking of buying something for your intended?
No, there's no one like that, but...
Still, it might not hurt to have a look
for the future.
Anyway, you've got to start on all sorts of
things while you're still young, like you are now.
Otherwise, you'll never build a fortune
like mine.
My new lord...
note: followed by #634 variant ' I await your orders...'

en: May God's salvation be with you, too.
The sky, birds in flight, clouds drifting...
Where hearts are warm, the world is home.
Let us pray to the Lord together...
You look rather pale.
Is something ailing you...?
God created this world...
Life is the most precious thing
God ever invented.
Those who would defile God's invention,
I simply cannot forgive.
(Sophistry.
Until quite recently, God's existence
was a mere tool of politics, was it not?)
Calstatt was once home to many devout folk,
and crowds used to come to worship, but
these days more people come for funerals.
Recently, some people calling themselves
vampire hunters came here.
They say a vampire is in this town...
Perhaps...
note: msg 181112 ends here; msg 181145 continues with #4629

en: Might you know something about it?
note: also opens msg 181529, so it stands as a full question

en: It's just a feeling I had, that's all.
(So the hunters chose this church as their base.)
What sort of past you have,
I cannot know... But
I see a pale ambition in your eyes.
I beg you, cast off that wicked ambition and
live with a peaceful heart.
(Cast off my wicked ambition
he says?)
note: leading space: follows '(Cast off my wicked ambition' + '...'

en: Ah, forgive me. That was rude of me to say.
